property_summary: For every call to C.fallback sending exactly 10 ether and with a strictly-increasing block.timestamp, the reference contract only forwards its entire balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0 (so address(c).balance == 0 after the call whenever block.number % 15 == 0), whereas the mutant forwards on block.number % 15 == 1 instead — this changes address(c).balance for some block numbers and thus violates the universal rule.
change_summary: Change the conditional to check block.number % 15 == 1 so the transfer occurs on different blocks and may cause reentrancy/transfer differences observable at the fallback.
